logs.title: Logs
logs.exportHint: Downloads every entry that matches the filters, for the whole period, oldest first.

coordinatorRequest.confirmMessage: Notify a coordinator that your team needs help? Coordinators can then read your chat and assist you.

users.title: User Management

actions.selfDisabled: You cannot edit, deactivate, or delete your own account here. Use your profile instead.

edit.title: Edit User
edit.roleChangeMessage: Are you sure you want to change {{name}}'s role from {{oldRole}} to {{newRole}}?
edit.guestHint: Guests can only upgrade themselves to an account.

delete.title: Delete User
delete.message: All data of {{name}} is anonymized at once and for good. This cannot be undone.
delete.immediateLabel: Anonymize for good right away (GDPR Art. 17, cannot be undone)
delete.graceMessage: {{name}} is deactivated and deleted. The account can be restored for 30 days, after that the data is anonymized for good. A restored account stays deactivated until you activate it.

restore.success: {{name}} has been restored. The account is still deactivated. “Activate” in the row allows the sign-in again.
restore.anonymizedHint: Already anonymized. Restoration is no longer possible

invite.title: Invite a person
invite.intro: The person you invite receives an email and chooses their own password. You never set or pass on a password.
invite.displayNameHelper: A suggestion for the sign-up form. They can change it.
invite.successNotDelivered: Invitation for {{email}} created, but it could not be sent. Check the email settings, then resend it.
invite.mailDisabled: Email delivery is not configured on this deployment. Invitations can be created but not delivered.

errors.emailBelongsToActiveUser: This email address already belongs to an active account in this organization.
errors.emailBelongsToUser: This email address already belongs to an account.
errors.emailBelongsToInactiveUser: This email address belongs to a deactivated account in this organization.
errors.emailBelongsToDeletedUser: This email address belongs to a deleted account. Restore that account: switch on "Show deleted" at the top of user management, then "Restore".

invitations.heading: Pending invitations
invitations.resendSuccess: A new invitation was sent to {{email}}. The old link no longer works.
invitations.revokeMessage: The invitation link for {{email}} stops working immediately.

sendReset.title: Send password link
sendReset.message: {{name}} receives an email with a link to set a new password. You will not see that password.
sendReset.noEmail: This account has no email address.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

users.takeover: You took over the administration. These accounts are deactivated now: {{names}}.

org.title: Organisation Settings
org.languagesHelp: Languages offered in multilingual content fields (titles, descriptions, tasks). Pick from the list or type any ISO code. German is always enabled.
org.languagesAdd: Add a language (type an ISO code, e.g. fr)

legal.intro: Here you can override your organisation's legal texts. A field left blank falls back to the text of the installation.

retention.intro: Retention periods for personal data (GDPR deletion classes). The daily deletion job applies these periods automatically. Numbers such as teams, answers and points stay for the statistics.

classDesc.LK_A: How long guests can still reach their result, the scoreboard and the feedback form after a run ends. The guest accounts are deleted afterwards. The team rosters then show “Deleted member” in place of the name. The number of members stays.
classDesc.LK_B: Chat messages & uploaded media (after a run ends)
classDesc.LK_C: After this period the app replaces the team names with “Team 1”, “Team 2” and every remaining name in the team rosters with “Deleted member”. Points and results stay.
classDesc.LK_H: After this period the app deletes the content of text and quiz answers, scanned codes, the comments on scores and the comments in the feedback. The answers themselves, the points and the feedback ratings stay as numbers.

backup.title: Backups
backup.stated_one: A backup of the installation can hold deleted data for {{count}} more day. The operator of the installation sets this value.
backup.stated_other: A backup of the installation can hold deleted data for {{count}} more days. The operator of the installation sets this value.
backup.assumed_one: The operator of the installation has not stated yet how long backups hold deleted data. The app assumes {{count}} day. Ask the operator before you name the value in your privacy policy.
backup.assumed_other: The operator of the installation has not stated yet how long backups hold deleted data. The app assumes {{count}} days. Ask the operator before you name the value in your privacy policy.

retention.privacyHint: The template for the privacy policy takes these periods when you insert it. If you change a period later, change your privacy policy too.

media.intro: Participant media stored for this organisation. Purging deletes every file of a type immediately, ahead of the retention period for chat and media. It is for the case that the organisation must erase sooner.
media.dialogWhat: All stored {{type}} of the participants of this organisation are deleted irreversibly. The submissions stay and show “Medium removed” in place of the medium.
media.dialogScores: Scores, points and leaderboards stay unchanged.

mail.heading: Email delivery
mail.description: Clavis sends invitations and password links through the configured mail server. Send a test message before an event to confirm delivery works.
mail.disabled: Not configured. Invitations and password links will not be delivered.
mail.testSuccess: Test message sent to {{email}}. It should arrive within seconds. If it does not, check the spam folder.
mail.testFailed: The mail server rejected the message: {{error}}

org.autoStartLabel: Start runs automatically at their planned time
org.autoStartHelpOn: Planned runs start by themselves at their start time.
org.autoStartHelpOff: The start time is only a plan, and the game lead starts the run by hand.
